hero.heading: Our Services – Professional Fence, Deck & Driveway Care in Middle Tennessee
hero.subheading: We provide expert cleaning, staining, sealing, and restoration services for wood structures and driveways across Nashville, Franklin, Brentwood, Murfreesboro, and all of Middle Tennessee.
hero.climate_note: Our work is built for our local climate — protecting against heavy rain, high humidity, and strong sun so your property looks great and lasts longer.

wood_services.name: Fence Staining & Sealing
wood_services.desc: We clean, brighten, and apply high-quality stain and sealer to privacy fences, picket fences, and farm fences. This protects the wood and gives it a fresh, even finish.

wood_services.name: Deck & Pergola Care
wood_services.desc: Full cleaning, staining, and sealing for decks, pergolas, arbors, and other outdoor wood structures. We make your outdoor living spaces look beautiful and stay protected.

wood_services.name: New Build Stain Finishes
wood_services.desc: Perfect first-time staining for newly installed fences, decks, and wood structures. We help you choose the right color and finish for long-lasting beauty.

wood_services.name: Maintenance Coats & Cleaning
wood_services.desc: Regular maintenance keeps your wood in top condition. We provide yearly or bi-yearly cleaning and fresh maintenance coats to extend the life of your fence or deck.

wood_services.name: Full Restorations & Minor Repairs
wood_services.desc: We restore older or weathered wood structures. This includes deep cleaning, minor board replacement, tightening hardware, and complete refinishing so your fence or deck looks like new again.

driveway_services.name: Driveway Cleaning & Brightening
driveway_services.desc: We thoroughly clean aggregate and blacktop driveways to remove dirt, stains, mildew, and tire marks for a fresh appearance.

driveway_services.name: Aggregate Driveway Staining & Sealing
driveway_services.desc: Professional staining and sealing that protects your gravel-style driveway from water damage, UV fading, and wear.

driveway_services.name: Blacktop / Asphalt Driveway Sealing
driveway_services.desc: High-quality sealing that extends the life of your asphalt driveway and gives it a clean, dark finish.

driveway_services.name: Driveway Crack Repair & Patching
driveway_services.desc: We fill minor cracks and patch small damaged areas to prevent bigger problems and keep your driveway looking smooth and well-maintained.

process_steps.title: Free On-Site Estimate
process_steps.body: We visit your property, inspect the fence/driveway, and give you clear recommendations and pricing.

process_steps.title: Thorough Cleaning
process_steps.body: We remove dirt, mildew, and old finishes so new stain or sealer bonds properly.

process_steps.title: Repairs (if needed)
process_steps.body: Minor fixes are completed before finishing.

process_steps.title: Professional Application
process_steps.body: We apply premium products using the best methods for even coverage and deep protection.

process_steps.title: Final Walkthrough
process_steps.body: We clean up the site and make sure you're 100% happy with the results.
